Phosphorus measurements and published bounds

These are original discrete lake samples. Each row below keeps its published method, sampling depth, fraction and unit basis. Numeric-only medians describe the reported numeric subset. The mean interval includes every result in that exact cohort when all bounds are known, with open or closed endpoints retained; it is not an annual flow-weighted concentration.

Each narrow-profile ResultIdentifier stays distinct. When multiple full-profile rows are identical, their original candidate positions are retained as a set rather than assigned by response order.

Explore original records

Exact selected comparison dimensions
Circles show reported numeric results. Open triangles and vertical lines show the published left-censor interval. Unknown or incompatible limits stay in the original-record table without a numeric plot position. Every original qualifier and status remains available; there is no initial quality-code exclusion.

Reproduce and receive
The retained capture manifest binds every original response to its original query, available acquisition metadata, byte length and SHA-256. Fields absent from the source-host receipt remain explicitly unavailable. The analytical module preserves every source field and derives exact method/depth/unit annual cohorts; a header-only or HTTP 204 response is retained as an explicit empty response. Use the included native importer to open the three discrete observation editions and add this scientific document through the existing ordered report picker.
